title: Coastal San Diego land and shoreline geography
sourceTemporalCoverage: Mixed chart-source dates, preserved per feature where supplied; extraction date is not a shoreline survey date.
crs: EPSG:4326 / WGS 84 longitude, latitude in decimal degrees
transformations: Queried NOAA ENC Direct to GIS Approach layers 238 (land polygons) and 88 (coastline polylines), requesting WGS 84 GeoJSON.
Server generalization requested at 0.000025 degrees and coordinate rounding at six decimal places; these are rendering settings, not claimed survey accuracy.
Selected intersecting features retained whole; no geometry snapped to ant observations and no hand-drawn land or survey boundary added.
Properties reduced to feature kind, NOAA source IDs, chart cell, name and reported source dates/indicators; chart geometry is preserved as returned.
Display should clip to a study-site viewport and project both geometry and published ant GPS coordinates through the same transform.
caveats: A geographic backdrop only: it contains no ant occurrence, colony identity, battlefield, habitat classification, research-site boundary, or soil polygons.
NOAA chart geometry has mixed source dates and does not reconstruct the historical shoreline for either survey period.
Whole intersecting chart features extend beyond the query envelope; fit the ant-study coordinates and clip the viewport rather than fitting the full feature extent.
This converted GIS product is not certified for navigation.
No commercial aerial basemap, author map raster, California State Parks geometry, or generated geographic imagery is bundled.
